units.note: Greek has ἡμᾶς governing the participles μὴ προεισδεδεμένους ... βουλευομένους, while English renders 'you ... us'; Greek pronoun is odd (ὑμᾶς expected), so left alone, no fix proposed.
Sentence breaks off at εἰ δὲ and resumes at the start of ch. 33 (μή, τούτων τὴν ἡσυχίαν ἔχειν); English handles the seam correctly.

findings.quote: set about piratical violence at sea and seized Pylus in violation of treaty
findings.problem: Greek: κατὰ μὲν θάλατταν βιάζεσθαι καὶ παρασπονδεῖν ἐπεβάλοντο Πύλον. ἐπεβάλοντο is 'they undertook/attempted', governing the infinitives and Πύλον; it does not say Pylus was taken. 'Piratical' is not in the Greek.
findings.proposed_fix: set about attacking Pylus by sea, by force and in breach of treaty
